{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''Kyuzo language''' was the native tongue of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Kyuzo/Legends|Kyuzo]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Embo/Legends|Embo]] spoke it and fellow bounty hunter [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were able to understand it, as were [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Kyuzo language was developed for ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series by series supervising director [[Dave Filoni]] and is comprised primarily of intentionally mispronounced French words. The source material for these words were children's books about [[Wikipedia:The Smurfs|The Smurfs]].<ref name="Bounty Hunters Episode Featurette">{{SW|url=video/bounty-hunters-episode-featurette|text="Bounty Hunters" Episode Featurette}}</ref>
